about: Hook formulas with real evidence (docs/slideshow-refs/refs.json, reports/Slideshow hook bank 2026-11-13.md). `match` is a regex lint.mjs tests slide 1 against; `ours` are Locturne-situation lines to start from, never copies.

formulas.pattern: me at [time] / when [trigger] / my room at 2am … [the habit nobody admits]
ours: me in bed at 1am doing sleep math like it's a group project
me in bed every morning letting tiktok decide my mood
me at 1:40am promising tomorrow i'll sleep early
when the alarm goes off and i open tiktok "just to wake up"
my room at 2am when i told everyone i'd be asleep by 11
me in bed at 3am watching a man restore a rusty knife

formulas.pattern: when it's finally ___ time [the guilty ritual]

when it's finally phone-in-the-dark-until-2am time
the noise i make when it's finally lie-in-bed-and-scroll time

rules: Lowercase, plain, 3–14 words on multi-slide decks (common in every top list; no controlled study).
Hook names the viewer's habit or another person's conflict, never a feature or the app (Larry: feature/self hooks 0.9–2.7K).
A number in the hook when the job is save.
